rationale: The refreshed translation places one positive existential constant before all rate and threshold quantifiers, matching the source's absolute-constant scope. It preserves the Poisson law, center, additive threshold range, inclusive two-sided event, prefactor, and exact c t^2/lambda decay. Direct formulation on the canonical Poisson measure is equivalent to formulation for any random variable with that law, and the explicit positive-rate condition only removes a vacuous zero-rate domain. Both implications hold, so the audit is faithful-equivalent and needs no adjudication.
